scientific_scope_status: Acquired scoped reviews accept private uniform perfect-matching survival with complete reset-completed decoder, sharp full-code loss coefficient and paid routing. A separately reviewed v9 six-state test constructs the full logical instrument, including every decoder Kraus/leakage output, and obeys the operator identity F=(2/3)W for every bath state. Existing guards consume accepted subnormalized id_payload tensor memory-filter maps, not a scalar pass probability.
